messages:
sec-oncall: Alert from IDS — multiple external POSTs to broker 9092 with SASL PLAIN auth observed in the wild. Potential exploit (unconfirmed) against brokers still exposing PLAINTEXT listeners. tagging eng-sre and eng-security.

maria: Copy. Can you paste the alert payload? any CVE id?

sec-oncall: Logs attached in S3 -> s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1795123456/logs.tar.gz (short TL;DR: auth attempts with default usernames, followed by suspicious produce requests). No confirmed CVE ID yet but behavior matches public exploit chatter.

aj: I see the IDS signature, matching a remote exploit that enumerates SASL users then sends crafted produce batches. We should treat as exploited-in-the-wild.

thomas: Immediate mitigations: 1) block external 9092/PLAINTEXT at LB/firewall 2) temporarily enforce listener.ssl.endpoint.identification.algorithm on brokers 3) rotate broker service accounts in KMS. Who can patch firewall rules now?

elaine: I can do firewall rules via cloud console (have RBAC). Doing a quick deny rule for 0.0.0.0/0 -> kafka-prod-9092 now. Will post when applied.

patrick-support: Heads up — if we block 9092 we may disrupt customers on legacy configs. Preparing customer advisory draft for minimal impact.

deploy-bot: @sec-oncall created incident INC-2026-1201 and started a runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/INC-2026-1201

sec-oncall: Elaine — thanks. After firewall block: 1) enable PLAINTEXT->SSL forced via listener override for public ALBs 2) rollout hotpatch to brokers (package kafka-server 2.8.3->2.8.3-patch1) that disables SASL PLAIN default handlers 3) rotate KMS keys used by broker keystore.

maria: Patch build is ready: PR  https://git.internal/redwood/kafka/merge/4321 — contains change to default listeners + backport of CVE mitigation. Need 2 approvers. Can we do canary on 3 brokers?

aj: Recommend canary in us-west-2 (non-critical cluster) 1 broker first, smoke produce/consume, then rolling restart. I'll own smoke tests.

thomas: RBAC note — we need temporary elevated permissions for aj to perform rolling restarts across prod clusters (system-sre role). Who approves? @sec-oncall?

sec-oncall: Approve temporary system-sre elevate for aj for 2 hours. Ensure actions are audited.

elaine: Firewall rule applied at 1795123502 — blocking PLAINTEXT from internet. Leaving internal subnets open for internal traffic.

patrick-support: Draft advisory ready (internal): "We are mitigating a security issue affecting some Kafka configurations that expose PLAINTEXT/SASL PLAIN to public networks. We are applying emergency mitigations that may require brief rolling restarts. We'll share timelines in 30 min." Will post to customers once we know rollback plan.

aj: Starting canary patch on kafka-canary-01 (us-west-2) at 1795123530. Steps: pull patched package, apply config override, restart service. Smoke tests: produce 100 msgs across partitions, verify consumer lag and KMS-encrypted keystore access.

deploy-bot: Deploy job kafka/patched/4321 started (job id: d-99877).

aj: Canary results: produce/consume OK, no errors in keystore access. Verified KMS logs show no unexpected key access besides our run. No auth bypass observed on patched broker. Rolling to rest of cluster with 30s drain windows.

maria: Merging PR 4321 with emergency tag. Opening hotpatch release v2.8.3-2026-01. Notify eng-runtime and infra.

thomas: Reminder: update audit logging to include explicit broker config change events and KMS key rotate events — we need this for postmortem. Who will ensure logs are forwarded to SIEM?

elaine: Forwarding broker admin and KMS audit logs to splunk index security-audit now.

patrick-support: Customer advisory (external) scheduled for 1795123700 — short notice about emergency maintenance and mitigation steps + link to support form. I'll sync with legal on wording.

sec-oncall: Good. Action items: [x] Block PLAINTEXT external (elaine) [x] Canary patch (aj) [x] Merge + rollout (maria) [x] KMS rotate + audit (elaine) [x] Customer comms (patrick-support). Next: collect forensic logs and prepare internal incident timeline. Assigning postmortem to thomas.

maria: All prod clusters patched by 1795123605. No customer-facing failures reported after canary.

aj: Running final verification sweep for all clusters; will report within 10m.

thomas: I'll start the evidence collection: snapshot /var/log/kafka, broker configs, symlinked keystore backups, and KMS access logs. Dropping to S3 path s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1795123456/postmortem/

sec-oncall: Closing immediate emergency window. Keep channel open for follow-ups. Great quick work team :thumbsup:

patrick-support: Posting external advisory now. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-1201

aj: Final verification complete at 1795123610 — no anomalous auth attempts after firewall + patches. Will add notes to runbook.

sec-oncall: Marking thread resolved. Follow-up: postmortem due in 72h, include remediation to disable PLAINTEXT by default and a KMS key rotation playbook.
